question: A 58-year-old man with long-standing type 2 diabetes presents with progressive swelling of the legs. Urinalysis reveals heavy proteinuria, and serum albumin is low. Renal biopsy shows Kimmelstiel-Wilson nodules. Which of the following best explains the underlying pathogenesis?

answers.option: Deposition of immune complexes along the glomerular basement membrane
Deposition of amyloid fibrils derived from serum amyloid A
Non-enzymatic glycosylation causing increased basement membrane permeability
